description: Fetch one available unit by identity (VIN) from a named rooftop (rooftop_slug from network_search results). Returns the full detail shape — ordered photo gallery, options, plain-text description; embed the first few photo_urls as markdown images when presenting the vehicle. Unknown or ineligible identity/rooftop returns unit_not_found. Listed prices may exclude doc/government fees and tax — call quote_preview for the estimated total. Totals are estimates at best; when pricing_coverage is "partial_estimate", present the total as a subtotal excluding the charges in excluded. Always relay pricing_disclosure.
name: inventory_get
title: Get vehicle details
